# Support

A quick guide depending on what you need.

## I have a question or want to discuss an idea

Head to [Discussions](https://github.com/mattstrayer/pypx/discussions). Open-ended questions, ideas, and "is this even a good idea?" conversations all live there.

## I think I found a bug

Open a [bug report](https://github.com/mattstrayer/pypx/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include reproduction steps and which component (web, api, goopy, deployment) is affected.

## I want to request a feature

File a [feature request](https://github.com/mattstrayer/pypx/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). For larger ideas, consider starting a discussion first to gauge interest.

## I found a security vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue. Follow the disclosure process in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) — report privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/mattstrayer/pypx/security/advisories/new) or email.

## Something else

For anything that doesn't fit above, start a [Discussion](https://github.com/mattstrayer/pypx/discussions/new/choose).
